rationale: The stock gapped down ~11.6% on earnings and has been recovering from a $185 low to $202.48, now sitting at 76% of today's range and near the 9-EMA ($202.54), suggesting the initial panic selling has largely been absorbed. However, the spread is wide at 41.5 bps, price action in the last 5 candles shows indecision with small-range bars and declining momentum, and the negative news sentiment with unfavorable estimate revisions creates directional ambiguity. With 112 minutes to close and no clear technical catalyst for continuation in either direction, the risk/reward does not justify a new position.
